g.title: WebAgentStep
g.text: One WebAgent step: challenge handling, write-ahead safety, execution, and commit

g.title: start
g.text: (stop immediately if the task already timed out)

g.title: challenge
g.text: headed report mode: notify + bounded human wait

g.title: plan
g.text: loop/strategy state + bounded history + exposed tool schemas
retry invalid planner output with an explicit repair hint

g.title: blocked
g.text: close browser unless isolated reset must retain it

g.title: write_ahead
g.text: assess replay policy -> set pending_action -> persist before execution

g.title: execute
g.text: exposure, execution, and risk policies + per-tool timeout

g.title: post
g.text: wait, then re-observe; done reuses the pre-action state

g.title: record
g.text: failure tracking + step history + strategy result + hooks

g.title: commit
g.text: clear pending_action + persist next_step and evidence
